notes.title: Patch 1.0.7 now live!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.7 is now live. Here you can find what has been changed and / or fixed in this patch

[h1]1.0.7[/h1]
-Fixed a bug where you could sometimes pass through the sealed gates in the fourth operation.
-Fixed a bug where the gmae sould occasionally crash when falling through the trap door in the boss room of the sixth operation.
-Fixed a bug where the game would crash when jumping from the roof of the basilica in the seventh operation.

[h1]1.0.6[/h1]
-Fixed a bug in the third operation where a the lights would sometimes pass through the walls.

-Added the version number in the log file

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 now live
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.5 is now live.
Here you can find all the changes in this version. Previous versions changes are listed as well.

[h1]1.0.5[/h1]
-Fixed a bug where the boxes in mission 3 and 9 would randomly kill you.
-Fixed a bug where Laika would teleport at the location of the abstraction if the timer ended during a climbing animation.
-Fixed a bug where the game would sometime freeze when entering a boss room.


[h1]1.0.4[/h1]
-Fixed a bug where Laika could end up stuck in a box in mission 9.
-Fixed the audio effect of the grinders in operation 10. Now they should loop correctly.


[h1]1.0.3[/h1]
-Added the current version of the build in the main menu.

-Fixed a bug where the camera would remain stuck on the wrong room.
-Fixed a bug with the flame animation in operation 8.

[h1]1.0.2[/h1]
-Fixed a bug where the soldiers in operation 5 would sometimes remain stuck in the Firing animation.

-Added the correct button tooltip to the keyboard's tutorial in operation 1.

[h1]1.0.1[/h1]
-Fixed a bug where some doors wouldn't behave correctly in operation 9

-Corrected some in-game dialogues.
